skill.name: seo-content-writer
skill.description: Creates search-optimized articles from topic briefs, keywords, audience goals, and target word counts. Produces structured content packages with metadata and linking suggestions.
skill.summary: Create reader-focused SEO articles with outlines, metadata, calls to action, and supporting content elements.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The sole static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a referenced file path. The skill contains prompt-only SEO guidance and no executable command.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses Markdown backticks to format a relative documentation path. It contains no Ruby syntax, shell command, or execution instruction.

content.user_title: Create Search-Optimized Content That Serves Readers
content.value_statement: Producing useful articles that also meet search requirements takes careful planning. This skill creates structured, reader-focused content from keywords and topic briefs.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes a topic, primary keyword, and related semantic terms.
Builds article outlines with logical H2 and H3 sections.
Writes introductions, body sections, conclusions, and calls to action.
Provides title options, meta descriptions, key takeaways, and FAQ sections.
Suggests internal links and integrates keywords with reader-focused language.
limitations: Does not perform live keyword research or inspect search result pages.
Cannot verify statistics, citations, or claims without trusted source material.
Does not guarantee rankings, traffic gains, or search engine approval.
Requires a clear topic, audience, keyword set, and content goal.

use_cases.title: Publish Educational Blog Posts
use_cases.description: Turn a topic brief into a structured article with metadata, takeaways, and reader-focused sections.

use_cases.title: Draft Service Content
use_cases.description: Create search-focused service pages that explain benefits, answer common questions, and include a clear call to action.

use_cases.title: Scale Editorial Production
use_cases.description: Convert approved briefs into consistent first drafts that editors can review, fact-check, and refine.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic SEO Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an article about [topic] for [audience]. Target [word count] words and use [primary keyword] naturally.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have a topic, audience, keyword, and length.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Complete Content Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO content package for [topic]. Include an outline, article, five titles, meta description, takeaways, internal links, and FAQs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing a publication-ready first draft.

prompt_templates.title: Follow a Detailed Content Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Write for [audience] using this brief: [brief]. Prioritize [search intent], include [semantic keywords], cite only [approved sources], and end with [CTA].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when brand, intent, source, and conversion requirements are defined.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Expert-Level Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a comprehensive article on [topic] for [audience]. Address [questions], compare [options], use [evidence], and demonstrate expertise without unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex topics requiring evidence, nuanced structure, and strong trust signals.

output_examples.input: Create a 1,200-word guide to email segmentation for small online stores. Target the keyword email segmentation strategy.
output: Title: Email Segmentation Strategy for Small Online Stores
Meta description: Learn how to segment store subscribers, send relevant campaigns, and improve email performance with a practical step-by-step strategy.
Outline: Segmentation basics, useful customer data, priority segments, campaign examples, measurement, and common questions.

output_examples.input: Write a service page for a local bookkeeping firm. Target monthly bookkeeping services and include a consultation call to action.
output_examples.output: A structured service page explaining monthly bookkeeping, ideal clients, included tasks, expected benefits, frequently asked questions, and a consultation call to action.

best_practices: Provide search intent, audience details, target length, primary keyword, and approved sources.
Review every factual claim, statistic, citation, and experience statement before publication.
Edit the draft for brand voice, originality, accessibility, and natural keyword placement.
anti_patterns: Do not request keyword repetition that harms clarity or reading quality.
Do not publish generated statistics, citations, or experience claims without verification.
Do not treat a first draft as guaranteed to rank or perform.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, audience, search intent, primary keyword, related terms, target length, brand voice, approved sources, and desired call to action.

faq.question: Can this skill research current search results?
faq.answer: No. It does not browse or inspect current search results unless the host tool separately provides that capability and relevant data.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher search rankings?
faq.answer: No. Rankings depend on competition, authority, technical quality, links, user behavior, content quality, and search engine changes.

faq.question: Can it create meta descriptions and title options?
faq.answer: Yes. The requested content package can include three to five titles and a concise meta description.

faq.question: How should factual claims be handled?
faq.answer: Supply trusted sources and require citations. A qualified reviewer should verify every claim, statistic, quotation, and source before publication.

faq.question: Can the output match a brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide voice guidelines, example passages, preferred terminology, prohibited language, and audience expectations for a closer match.
